roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: Staining inside a building may relate to roof flashings, penetrations, drainage or damage to the roof surface. Water can travel before it appears indoors, so a ceiling stain does not locate the entry point. We assess whether a local waterproofing treatment is suitable or broader roof work needs another trade.
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 室内水渍可能与屋顶泛水板、穿透点、排水或屋面破损有关。水可能先流动一段距离再进入室内，因此天花板水渍并不能定位入口。我们评估局部防水是否适合，或是否需由其他工种处理更大范围屋顶工程。

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 我们根据屋面材料、状况及安全通行条件选择维修方案。书面范围列明局部防水工作，以及需要另行安排的屋顶维修。

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: Describe whether the leak follows heavy rain, particular wind conditions or another pattern. Tell us the roof material if known, the building height and whether there have been repairs in the same area. Existing reports or safely taken indoor photos can help the initial conversation.
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 请描述渗漏是否发生于大雨、特定风向或其他情况下。如已知，请提供屋面材料、建筑高度及同一区域的维修历史。已有报告或安全拍摄的室内照片可帮助初步沟通。

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: We inspect safely accessible surfaces and explain where concealed or unreachable junctions need further investigation. We identify any drainage, structural or roof-covering repairs that require a separate scope before the waterproofing work proceeds.
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 我们检查安全可达的表面，并说明哪些隐蔽或无法到达的交接处需要进一步调查。防水施工前，列明需单独安排的排水、结构或屋面维修。
材料适用性、基层处理与通行

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: A proposed treatment must suit the existing surface and the particular detail being repaired. We consider the material condition, previous coatings or sealants, required preparation and how the treated area joins the surrounding roof. Covering an unstable or deteriorated base may leave the underlying problem unresolved.
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 处理方案必须适合现有表面和具体维修细部。我们考虑材料状况、旧涂层或密封胶、准备要求，以及处理区域与周边屋面的衔接。覆盖不稳或老化基层，可能留下未解决的根本问题。

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: Height, roof geometry and the work area affect access arrangements. We confirm safe access and the permitted work area before starting. Preparation, application, curing and any agreed checks follow the chosen repair system. For leaks at an exposed balcony rather than the roof, see
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 高度、屋顶形状及施工位置影响通行安排。开工前确认安全通道和允许施工区域，按所选维修系统完成准备、施工、养护及约定检查。若渗漏来自露天阳台而非屋顶，可查看

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: The affected roof detail, previous coatings, material compatibility and safe access can matter more than the stain size. Your written quote defines the area treated, preparation, materials and checks, plus exclusions and any further investigation or other trade work required.
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 受影响细部、旧涂层、材料兼容性和安全通行，可能比水渍面积更影响施工。书面报价列明处理区域、基层准备、材料及检查，也说明不包含项目、进一步调查或其他工种工作。

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: Weather and surface moisture can affect when preparation and application are suitable. Material curing and the agreed checks also influence completion. We discuss timing after assessing those factors. If the findings point to work beyond the proposed treatment, the revised scope and cost are confirmed before additional work proceeds.
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 天气与表面含水情况影响何时适合准备和施工，材料养护及约定检查也影响完工。评估这些因素后再沟通时间。如发现超出原方案的工作，会在增加施工前确认调整范围与费用。

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: We explain any access restrictions and care requirements for the treated area. Keep clear of the work zone until it is released for use. Do not climb onto the roof to inspect the repair or collect photographs; discuss follow-up access with the team.
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 我们说明施工区通行限制及保养要求。在允许使用前，请远离施工区域。不要爬上屋顶检查维修或拍照；后续检查通行应与团队沟通。

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: After rain, note whether the indoor staining or dampness changes and let us know if water entry persists or appears elsewhere. Existing marks may remain after the source has been addressed, so describe new moisture separately from old discoloration. General process questions are covered in the
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 雨后留意室内水渍或潮湿是否变化，渗水持续或转移位置时请反馈。水源处理后旧印迹可能仍在，请区分新潮湿与旧变色。一般流程问题可参阅

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: Send your suburb, building type and where water appears. Roof material, repair history and indoor photos are helpful if available; you can enquire without them. We confirm access and suitability before agreeing the waterproofing repair scope.
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 请提供郊区、建筑类型和渗水位置。如有屋面材料、维修历史及室内照片，也欢迎补充；没有这些资料同样可以咨询。我们先确认通行与适用性，再约定防水维修范围。

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: Leaks that appear only with wind-driven rain
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 只在风雨交加时出现的渗漏

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: A leak that appears only with wind-driven rain still needs its entry path assessed before a repair is selected. Tell us the wind direction if known, how long the rain had been falling and whether the same indoor patch becomes wet each time. A photograph of a ceiling mark helps locate the symptom, but does not prove which roof detail is leaking.
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 只在风雨交加时出现的漏水，也应先排查进水路径，再选择修复方案。请说明已知风向、降雨持续多久后开始漏水，以及每次是否都是室内同一位置变湿。天花水渍照片有助于定位症状，但不能证明具体是哪个屋顶节点进水。

roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: We compare the accessible surface, junctions and previous repairs with that history. Local treatment may suit an isolated detail with a sound surrounding base; widespread deterioration or inaccessible connections may need further investigation and a separate roof repair scope. Your quote should distinguish investigation, preparation, the area treated, safe access and any work by another trade.
roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 我们结合这些情况检查可安全接近的表面、交接节点与旧修补。周边基层完好、问题局限于单个节点时，可考虑局部处理；若大范围老化或连接处无法检查，则可能需要进一步排查，并另行明确屋顶维修范围。报价应区分排查、基层处理、处理区域、安全进场与其他工种工作。
